QuestInfo.name: Fourth Evan Launch Gift from the Admin
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has prepared a gift for you to celebrate the launch of Evan. If you're curious about the gift, talk to the Maple Admin.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has prepared 5 different cash items that look especially good on Evan. You can get the fourth item from the Maple Admin when you reach Lv. 20.
QuestInfo.2: You have received your fourth Evan Launch Gift from the Admin.

0.0: Wow, you've already reached Lv. 20? It's time for me to give you my fourth gift then.

yes.0: Please come see me when you're ready to receive my fourth gift.

no.0: It's a special gift that will be given out only until May 4th, so hurry over if you want it!
